paragraphs.text: Shenmeng ( Chinese: 蜃梦), the Plane of Mountains and Seas ( Chinese: 山海時空), is the plane featured in the Global Series: Jiang Yanggu & Mu Yanling set and March of the Machine Commander . It is inspired by the Chinese Classic of Mountains and Seas , a compilation of mythic geography and myth. It is home to the planeswalker Mu Yanling , and is the earliest place the planeswalker Jiang Yanggu has memories of.
The world is characterized by its many mountains , forests , plains , lakes, rivers, and oceans. It has rich flora and fauna.
The Arrow Bamboo Forest - a forest with a welcoming appearance that hides its deadly hostility, which was pacified by the arrival of Jiang Yanggu.

Cloud Dream Lake - a clanhold which Yanling and Li Shan were headed to when he collapsed and disappeared. The rainbows seen above the lake are nothing more than the ritual dancing of the Vivid Flying Fish .
The Dark Sea of Penglai - located in the north. Yanling searched for Li Shan there.
The Easternmost Valley - the first place Yanggu can remember.
The Eternal Divided Realm - located in the south. Yanling searched for Li Shan there.

Mount Zhaoyao - represented in Timber Gorge ( Global Series: Jiang Yanggu & Mu Yanling ), it is a forest of stones near the Western Seas, that reaches the clouds and land of wondrous treasures and strange animals.
Mu Yanling's village - destroyed by a crushing wave amid the roars of snarling beasts when Mu Yanling was a child. Her life was saved and she was taken in by Li Shan .
The Northern Mountains - deep in this mountain range linger the Earth-Origin Yak , who channel the power of the earth.
Ten Wizards Mountain - home to a large number of birds and covered by waterfalls. This is where Mu Yanling met Jiang Yanggu .
Village of the Jiuli Clan - Yanggu's foster clan
The Western Seas - near them lies Mount Zhaoyao.
Humans Clan of Cloud Dream Lake Jiuli Clan
Chiyou , teenage Jiuli-clan fire dancer
Jiang Yanggu , a teenage amnesiac who journeyed to find a legendary elixir to save his village from a waterborne plague
Li Shan , nomad and foster father of Yanling, presumed dead
Mu Yanling , a water mage orphaned by a deluge, seeking to study time magic to undo her foster father's death
Mowu , Jiang Yanggu's sapient dog
Yinglong , the Ancestor Dragon

The Global Series's name in Mandarin Chinese is 幻境奇谭, which can be translated as "Tales of Huanjing." Huanjing itself is a generic term used to convey the idea of "fantasy land." It's unclear if Huanjing was originally intended to be the name of the plane.
paragraphs.section: On the name of the plane

paragraphs.text: While the name of the "Plane of Mountains and Seas" was coined as such on this wiki, it entered canon when it was mentioned in Greg Weisman 's 2019 novel War of the Spark: Ravnica (page 193). It was subsequently back-translated into Chinese.
paragraphs.section: On the name of the plane

paragraphs.text: Later, during March of the Machine , Ten Wizards Mountain was printed as a Planechase card , featuring the name Shenmeng. This was later confirmed by Jay Annelli and Ethan Fleischer to be the name of this plane.
paragraphs.section: On the name of the plane

paragraphs.text: Shenmeng was named by cultural consultant Tan Shao Han. Its meaning was intentionally loose; "Meng" referred to 梦 (dream), with "Shen" being possibly read as either 沈 (a ritual sacrifice involving the drowning of animals), 深 ("of depths"), or 神 ("of gods or spirits"). The official Chinese translation of Ten Wizards Mountain uses 蜃梦 as planar type . 蜃 is a mythical sea monster known for creating mirages. The Japanese translation uses 沈夢 for Shenmeng.
